zh.title: 西班牙Plus Ultra航空全面停飛，最後的委內瑞拉航線也暫停
zh.summary: 西班牙Plus Ultra航空11月23日起全面停飛，最後營運的西班牙往返委內瑞拉航線也暫停，恢復日期未定。
body: 西班牙Plus Ultra航空11月23日公告，即日起暫停西班牙往返委內瑞拉的航班，何時復飛另行通知。埃菲社報導，委內瑞拉原是該公司僅存的航點；馬德里往返利馬和布宜諾斯艾利斯的航班已於11月17日停飛。
航空公司表示，停飛是財務與營運重整的一環，並指出燃油等營運成本明顯上升。歐洲通訊社報導，Plus Ultra仍在與債權人協商並評估重整方案。
航空公司將以電子郵件通知受影響旅客。透過旅行社購票者應聯絡原開票旅行社；透過官網或其他直售管道購票者可使用航空公司的申訴入口。航空公司表示，會優先處理出發日期較近的個案。

en.title: Spain’s Plus Ultra suspends all flights, including its last route to Venezuela
en.summary: Spanish carrier Plus Ultra suspended all flights on November 23, including its last remaining service between Spain and Venezuela. It has not announced a restart date.
body: Plus Ultra announced on November 23 that it was suspending flights between Spain and Venezuela from that day until further notice. Spanish news agency EFE reported that Venezuela was the airline’s last remaining destination after it stopped flights from Madrid to Lima and Buenos Aires on November 17.

The airline said the suspension was part of its financial and operational restructuring and cited sharply higher operating costs, particularly for fuel. Europa Press reported that Plus Ultra was still negotiating with creditors and assessing restructuring options.

Plus Ultra said it would notify affected passengers by email. Those who booked through a travel agency should contact the agency that issued the ticket, while passengers who booked directly can use the airline’s claims portal. The airline said it would prioritize passengers with the earliest departure dates.

公司仍在與債權人協商並評估重整方案。
航空公司將以電子郵件通知旅客，並分別由原開票旅行社或公司申訴入口處理購票事宜，優先處理近期出發的旅客。
